key_findings: Oxaliplatin upregulates CB1, CB2, 5HT1A, TRPV1 and FAAH in rat DRG in both sexes, with sex-specific changes in DAGL, MGL, NAPE-PLD and endocannabinoid levels.
In the lumbar spinal cord only TRPV1 mRNA was upregulated.
